method: Unmodified PC handlers, real ordered0x51ac10 lookup, native numeric/RNG and squared-distance helpers. Bounded CRT name-formatting, character binding and terrain callbacks are explicit adapters.
limits: Synthetic locator and actor tables; not runtime source attachment or actual level reachability.
No format directives, overlong native name buffers, invalid actor packet pointers, or nonfinite/overflow numeric operands.
Snap terrain refresh/check internals are recorded callback boundaries, not reconstructed by this suite.
Condition cases establish pointer presence only, not locator validity or source condition-chain execution.
